summary.en: US equities face a week of key technology earnings, including CoreWeave, and Tuesday's October CPI release on a fragile footing after the Nasdaq slid into correction territory amid post-midterm AI data-center regulatory concerns. Premarket futures point to a modest broad-based rebound following Friday's tech-led recovery, but the roughly 80% market-implied probability of a December Fed rate hike and firm core-services inflation expectations remain headwinds. The key test is whether CoreWeave's project-financing commentary and Tuesday's CPI print can stabilize the AI trade or trigger renewed selling.
summary.zh: 纳指在中期选举后的AI数据中心监管忧虑中跌入修正区间，美股以脆弱态势迎来包括CoreWeave在内的本周科技公司财报，以及周二公布的10月CPI。周五科技股领涨反弹后，盘前期货显示温和的广泛修复，但市场隐含的12月美联储加息概率约80%，叠加核心服务通胀偏强预期，仍构成阻力。关键考验在于CoreWeave的项目融资评论和周二CPI数据能否稳定AI交易，还是引发新一轮抛售。

title.en: Nasdaq in correction after post-midterm AI selloff; October CPI due Tuesday tests ~80% December rate-hike odds
title.zh: 纳指因中期选举后AI板块抛售跌入修正区间；10月CPI周二公布，检验约80%的12月加息概率

impact.en: The correction and elevated rate-hike odds create a two-sided risk: a hot CPI or weak CoreWeave guidance could deepen the selloff, while a soft print and constructive AI financing commentary could support a sustained repair.
impact.zh: 修正区间与高企的加息概率构成双向风险：CPI偏热或CoreWeave指引疲弱可能加深抛售，而数据偏软及AI融资面积极则可能支撑持续修复。

bullish: 周五科技股领涨反弹（SOXX +4.16%、纳指 +1.01%）及今晨期货全线小幅走高，表明卖压尚未完全主导 / Friday's tech-led rebound (SOXX +4.16%, Nasdaq +1.01%) and this morning's broad futures gains suggest sellers are not yet in full control
bearish: 市场隐含12月加息概率约80%，核心服务通胀预期偏强，限制修复空间 / ~80% market-implied December hike probability and firm core-services inflation expectations cap the repair

macroRisk.en: October CPI due Tuesday; a hot print could push December hike probability above 80% and extend the correction
macroRisk.zh: 10月CPI周二公布；数据偏热可能将12月加息概率推至80%以上并延长修正

title.en: CoreWeave, Applied Materials, Cisco report this week amid AI financing scrutiny and data-center regulatory pressure
title.zh: CoreWeave、应用材料、思科本周公布财报，面临AI融资审查与数据中心监管压力

impact.en: CoreWeave's commentary on project financing and debt management will be a key focus for assessing the AI trade; a constructive update could stabilize sentiment, while a weak one risks extending the correction.
impact.zh: CoreWeave关于项目融资和债务管理的评论将是评估AI交易的关键观察点；积极更新可能稳定情绪，疲弱则可能延长修正。

bearish: CoreWeave债务水平担忧及数据中心监管压力可能进一步压制AI板块 / CoreWeave debt concerns and data-center regulatory pressure may further weigh on the AI sector

macroRisk.en: Core services inflation estimated firm per Scotiabank; energy cost pass-through via airfare adds upside risk to CPI

ai.en: The AI and tech trade remains in focus: the Nasdaq is in correction, while the S&P 500 tech sector fell 7.3% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped over 12% on Thursday, their biggest one-day declines in more than six years. CoreWeave earnings are a key catalyst this week.
ai.zh: AI和科技交易仍是焦点：纳指处于修正区间，标普500科技板块周四跌7.3%、费城半导体指数跌超12%，均为六年多以来最大单日跌幅。CoreWeave财报是本周关键催化剂之一。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductors led Thursday's selloff with the Philadelphia SE index down over 12%, but SOXX rebounded 4.16% on Friday, the largest prior-session gain among tracked sector ETFs.

keyRisk.en: The roughly 80% market-implied probability of a December 25bp Fed hike, combined with firm core-services inflation expectations, is the primary macro overhang for the repair attempt.
keyRisk.zh: 市场隐含的12月加息25个基点概率约80%，叠加核心服务通胀偏强预期，是修复尝试的主要宏观压制因素。

note.en: The central thesis is that the market is attempting a repair after the post-midterm AI selloff, but the repair is fragile and conditional on Tuesday's CPI and CoreWeave's financing commentary. Two signals support stabilization: Friday's tech-led rebound (SOXX +4.16%, Nasdaq +1.01%) and this morning's broad futures gains (ES +0.89%, YM +1.28%) suggest sellers are not yet in full control, while WTI futures down roughly 4% and COMEX gold futures up about 1.5% premarket may reflect residual uncertainty. The 10-year yield is down 2bp and the dollar index down 0.47%, modest moves that neither strongly support nor undermine the repair. The key conflicting signal is the roughly 80% market-implied probability of a December 25bp hike, which caps the repair if CPI prints hot. I lean toward watching whether Tuesday's CPI and CoreWeave's project-financing commentary can sustain the rebound or trigger a second leg of selling.
note.zh: 核心判断是：中期选举后AI板块抛售引发的市场正在尝试修复，但修复脆弱，取决于周二CPI数据和CoreWeave的融资指引。两个信号支持企稳：周五科技股领涨反弹（SOXX +4.16%、纳指 +1.01%）以及今晨期货全线小幅走高（ES +0.89%、YM +1.28%），表明卖压尚未完全主导，而WTI期货盘前回落约4%、COMEX黄金期货上涨约1.5%可能反映残余不确定性。10年期美债收益率下行2个基点、美元指数下跌0.47%，变动温和，既未强力支撑也未明显削弱修复。关键矛盾信号是市场隐含的12月加息25个基点概率约80%，若CPI偏热将限制修复空间。我倾向于关注周二CPI和CoreWeave项目融资指引能否支撑反弹，否则修正可能加深。
